description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {C}{C}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Atsushi from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
